attchmntText: M TEK COPPER LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: M Tek Copper Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 14, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 1,22,20,738 for the quarter and 2,26,80,334 for the half year. Basic earnings per share stood at 0.45 for the quarter and 0.84 for the half year. Total revenue from operations was 92,93,92,668 for the quarter and 1,73,20,08,255 for the half year. The statutory auditors, M P Gohil & Co., issued a limited review report confirming no material misstatements. The results have been uploaded to the company website and will be published in newspapers.

attchmntText: M TEK COPPER LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
